live_high.selection: St Finbarrs To Win (1.62 / -161; St Finbarrs -1.5 pts handicap)
live_high.text: St Finbarrs to win at 1.62 (-161) is our selection for Sunday's McCarthy Insurance Group Cork Premier Senior Football Championship Final against Nemo Rangers at SuperValu Páirc Uí Chaoimh, a 4.00pm throw-in per Cork GAA's own event page. That page prints Nemo's route as a 1-15 to 0-16 semi-final win over Carrigaline and a 1-20 to 1-17 quarter-final win over Castlehaven, and St Finbarrs' route as a 2-12 to 0-16 semi-final win over Clonakilty plus what it calls a convincing quarter-final victory over Carbery, without a scoreline. OLBG's handicap market carries 14 of 18 tips on Nemo Rangers +1.5, a crowd lean we are taking the other side of. The Barrs are the selection at 1.62, inside the -250 to +10000 window, and the print leaves the Carbery margin unstated rather than filled in.

live_high.text: Back MT Melsungen to win at 1.54 (-185) in Wednesday's Group B trip to SC Jane Sandanski in Skopje (18:45 CET). Melsungen sit second in Group B on 6 points (3-0-2, 138:138) with a Main Round berth on the line after defeating group leaders Wisla Plock 28:26 in Round 5 behind goalkeeper Nebojsa Simic's 11 saves (including three straight crunch-time stops) and six goals apiece from Eric Balenciaga (6/6) and Aaron Mensing. Fourth-placed HC Vardar 1961 (1-0-4, 2 points, 154:158) are already eliminated from Main Round contention despite upsetting Nantes 33:27 behind Leon Ljevar's 7/9 shooting, and Melsungen already beat Vardar at home in Round 1. Melsungen to win is our call.

live_high.text: Max Verstappen to win the race is the selection at 3.48 (+248) for Sunday's 56-lap Formula 1 MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix over 308.432 kilometres at the Circuit of The Americas in Austin. Formula 1's official Austin race hub shows Verstappen immediately on the pace in Friday first practice, slotting second at 0.084 seconds behind Charles Leclerc's 1:36.052 benchmark and ahead of Lando Norris (+0.245s) and George Russell (+0.326s). Combined with 12 of 34 captured OLBG race-winner tips backing the Red Bull driver against a 22-car grid prior, our 27.3% win estimate prices Verstappen at 3.48 (+248).

live_high.text: Cucine Lube Civitanova to win the match at 1.44 (-227) is the selection for Sunday's SuperLega Round 2 fixture in Civitanova Marche against Pallavolo Padova. Volleyball World's official SuperLega table places Civitanova fourth on maximum three points after sweeping Rana Verona 3-0 in Round 1 with a 78-65 rally-point margin (1.200 point ratio). Padova sit eleventh on zero points and 0-3 in sets after managing only 56 total rally points against 75 conceded (0.746 ratio) in their opening defeat to Piacenza. Civitanova's serve-and-sideout superiority on home taraflex supports backing Lube to win.

live_high.text: Back Vero Volley Monza to win the match at 1.61 (-164) when they host Rana Verona in Sunday's SuperLega Round 2 clash at 17:00 UTC. Both sides seek their first league points of 2026/27, but Volleyball World's Round 1 stats show Monza far closer to parity in their four-set road loss at Prata di Pordenone (22-25, 25-19, 21-25, 22-25), out-killing Prata 47-45 in attack behind Frascio (15 points) and Velichkov (13 points) for a 0.957 point ratio (90:94). Verona were swept 0-3 at Civitanova (65:78 points, 0.833 ratio). Home court in Monza makes Vero Volley Monza our pick.

live_high.selection: Sir Susa Scai Perugia Match Winner (1.58 / -172)
live_high.text: Sir Susa Scai Perugia to win at 1.58 (-172) is our SuperLega Round 2 selection for Sunday 25 October, when Volleyball World lists the match in Perugia at 17:00 UTC, 18:00 local time. Perugia won their opener 3-2 at Acqua Sant'Anna Cuneo on 18 October, taking the deciding set 25-23 after losing the first 25-18; Ferre Reggers top-scored with 18 points and Kamil Semeniuk added 13. Tinet Prata di Pordenone are the visitors, and the away side's attack has to hold up against a Perugia block that scored seven points in Round 1. The price sits inside the -250 to +10000 window.
